text:
maria: Quick check-in: we want to flip the SDK routing default but console lacks per-route telemetry. Can we gate the flip?

aj: Absolutely. Need per-route tokens/sec, quota burn %, fallback_count, and p95 latency. Current proxy sampling drops route hints ~20%.

hk: Proposed canary: `routing_default_canary` per-org at 10%. Console shows a tiny card with routes + tokens + fallback %.

sdk-oliver: Python/TS/Go SDKs will rename header to `X-RW-Route-Hint` in upcoming releases. We can ship a server-side fallback to accept the old header for now.

sre-sarah: If we add fallback, emit `redwood.route_hint_fallback_total` with tenant label and `redwood.extra_tokens_from_fallback`. Add alert if fallback_rate > 3%.

product-anna: Docs: short migration FAQ and release note blurb. Make upgrade path clear.

aj: I'll add per-tenant preserve flag in the edge proxy `canary.preserve_route_hint=true` and expose it in the console toggle.

sdk-oliver: I'll open the Python PR with fallback logic and session-debounced warning.

maria: Action list: aj (proxy flag + console toggle), oliver (SDK + server fallback), sarah (metrics + alert), anna (docs). Timeline: canary next Wed, monitor 72h, decide Mon.

maria: Keep updates in this thread only. Short status posts please. :thumbsup:
